hero.title: DECENT LIFE FOR PEOPLE IN THE THIRD AGE
hero.desc: Bulgaria is the country in the European Union (EU) in which the elderly are most threatened by poverty, social exclusion and material difficulties, according to data from the European statistical service Eurostat. Bulgarian pensioners are also the most isolated from the Internet in the EU. Only one in ten people uses the web, and half of those who have internet access write e-mails, read news and search for information about goods. Only 2% of them shop online, and every third uses on social networks.

testimonials.first-revolution-desc: It is distinguished by the introduction of the steam engine, which led to the mechanization of production and the development of the railway transport.
testimonials.second-revolution-desc: It was characterized by the widespread spread of electricity and power lines, which increased production efficiency and stimulated industrial growth.
testimonials.third-revolution-desc: Also called the Digital Revolution, this era was marked by the introduction of computers, the Internet and automation, which radically changed the way production processes were managed and controlled.
testimonials.forth-revolution-desc: Focused on smart factories that use the Internet of Things (IoT), automated decision making and machine learning to further increase manufacturing efficiency.
testimonials.fifth-revolution-desc: This is the latest stage in the development, which involves the use of artificial intelligence not only for automation, but also for the integration of human creative and analytical potential

motto.desc: This is an innovative platform, a tool for creating a community. A community of people of the same age, with similar interests, new ideas, and new knowledge. A community for interaction and mutual support. The expected outcome is an improvement in quality of life, through active engagement in contemporary life, support for new skills and interests, and encouragement towards a healthy and fulfilling, dignified life!

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.introductionText: Pensa Club is committed to protecting your privacy and complying with all applicable data protection laws.
privacyPolicy.dataCollectionText: We collect information that you provide voluntarily, such as name, email address, phone number, and other necessary data for providing our services. Additionally, we may collect information automatically through cookies and other technologies.
privacyPolicy.dataUseCommunication: Communicating with you about services and updates
privacyPolicy.dataSharingService: This is necessary to provide services
privacyPolicy.dataProtectionText: We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data from unauthorized access, misuse, or disclosure.
privacyPolicy.userRightsAccess: Right to access your personal data
privacyPolicy.userRightsCorrection: Right to correct inaccurate personal data
privacyPolicy.userRightsDeletion: Right to request deletion of personal data under certain conditions
privacyPolicy.userRightsRestriction: Right to restrict processing of personal data under certain conditions
privacyPolicy.userRightsObjection: Right to object to processing of personal data for certain purposes
privacyPolicy.userRightsPortability: Right to data portability in a structured, commonly used format and transmit it to another controller
privacyPolicy.cookiesText1: Our website uses cookies. A cookie is a file containing an identifier (a string of letters and numbers) that is sent by a web server to a web browser and stored by the browser. The identifier is then sent back to the server each time the browser requests a page from the server.
privacyPolicy.cookiesText2: Cookies can be either 'persistent' cookies or 'session' cookies: a persistent cookie will be stored by a web browser and will remain valid until its set expiry date, unless deleted by the user before the expiry date; a session cookie, on the other hand, will expire at the end of the user session, when the web browser is closed.
privacyPolicy.cookiesText3: Cookies usually do not contain any information that personally identifies a user, but personal information that we store about you may be linked to the information stored in and obtained from cookies. We use only session cookies on our website.
privacyPolicy.cookiesText4: The names of the cookies that we use on our website, and the purposes for which they are used, are set out below: we use Google Analytics and Adwords on our website to recognize a computer when a user visits the website, improves the website's usability, analyzes the use of the website, administers the website, prevents fraud, improves the security of the website, and personalizes the website for each user.
privacyPolicy.cookiesText5: Most browsers allow you to refuse to accept cookies—for example: in Internet Explorer (version 10) you can block cookies using the cookie handling override settings available by clicking 'Tools', 'Internet Options', 'Privacy', and then 'Advanced'; in Firefox (version 128) you can block all cookies by clicking 'Tools', 'Options', 'Privacy', selecting 'Use custom settings for history' from the drop-down menu, and unticking 'Accept cookies from sites'; in Chrome (version 128), you can block all cookies by accessing the 'Customize and control' menu, clicking 'Settings', 'Show advanced settings', and 'Content settings', and then selecting 'Block sites from setting any data' under the 'Cookies' heading.
privacyPolicy.cookiesText6: Blocking all cookies will have a negative impact upon the usability of many websites. If you block cookies, you will not be able to use all the features on our website.
privacyPolicy.cookiesText7: You can delete cookies already stored on your computer—for example: in Internet Explorer (version 10), you must manually delete cookie files (you can find instructions for doing so at http://support.microsoft.com/kb/278835); in Firefox (version 24), you can delete cookies by clicking 'Tools', 'Options', and 'Privacy', then selecting 'Use custom settings for history', clicking 'Show Cookies', and then clicking 'Remove All Cookies'; in Chrome (version 29), you can delete all cookies by accessing the 'Customize and control' menu, clicking 'Settings', 'Show advanced settings', and 'Clear browsing data', and then selecting 'Delete cookies and other site and plug-in data' before clicking 'Clear browsing data.'
privacyPolicy.cookiesText8: Deleting cookies will have a negative impact on the usability of many websites.
privacyPolicy.cookiesText9: Website Planet is not responsible and advises you to consult legal experts if you apply the above template to your website.
privacyPolicy.policyChangesText: We may periodically update this policy. All changes will be posted on this page. We recommend you review it regularly.
privacyPolicy.contactText: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your rights, please contact us at: info@pensa.club
privacyPolicy.dataDetailsTypes: Types of collected data: Personal data (name, email address, phone number, address), Usage data (IP address, browser type, visit time, viewed pages)

privacyPolicy.dataDetailsRetention: Retention period: Personal data will be stored as long as necessary for the purposes for which it was collected or as required by law

privacyPolicy.dataDisclosureLaw: Law enforcement: when required by law
